text: {"reasoning":"To verify which channel drove the NA revenue increase, I build my own breakdown: revenue by channel by month across October and November 2026, filtered to the NA region. I include both grossRevenue and netRevenue (in case refunds shift the picture) plus orderCount as the record-count measure so I can judge whether each channel-month cell rests on a meaningful number of orders or just a handful. Monthly granularity on Commerce.orderedAt with a date range covering 2026-10-01 through 2026-11-30 gives me the two comparison periods directly, and splitting by Commerce.channel (partner, web) lets me compute each channel's month-over-month delta independently of the analyst's approach.","query":{"measures":["Commerce.grossRevenue","Commerce.netRevenue","Commerce.orderCount"],"dimensions":["Commerce.channel"],"time_dimensions":[{"dimension":"Commerce.orderedAt","granularity":"month","date_range":["2026-10-01","2026-11-30"]}],"filters":[{"member":"Commerce.region","operator":"equals","values":["NA"]}]}}
